note: New synthetic-only V6 semantic cases frozen before any real V6 call. Operation match is not semantic acceptance. Independent reviewer must inspect all visible strings, inferred cardinality, temporal meaning and scope.

cases.source: Create notes for each flashlight and its battery type.
cases.reason: Possessive attribute is not automatically a second note type
semantic_checks: English type Flashlight as independently identified class
battery type is a text property, not a second type

cases.source: Je veux des fiches pour mes appareils photo et leur fabricant.
cases.reason: French possessive field vs separate manufacturer entity
semantic_checks: fabricant is a property of the camera
No second manufacturer type and no translation drift

cases.source: Crea una ficha por cada moneda con su país de origen.
cases.reason: Spanish own entity with origin property
semantic_checks: country of origin as one string property
No separate Country entity unless explicitly requested

cases.source: Quiero notas de semilleros con el número de brotes de cada uno.
cases.reason: An explicit count without concrete value still demands integer property
semantic_checks: number of sprouts integer not string

cases.source: Je voudrais un type Salle avec le nombre de places assises.
semantic_checks: French user-facing explanation and field descriptions

cases.source: Please make a type for carts and their number of wheels.
semantic_checks: Cart as entity, wheels as count property

cases.source: Añade a Persona el mes de nacimiento aunque no sepamos el día ni el año.
cases.reason: Partial month-only date not representable as full date or numeric surrogate
semantic_checks: No integer/text birth-month workaround offered as if equivalent
Ask how to preserve unknown temporal precision or defer until partial-date support

cases.source: Je veux noter seulement le jour et le mois de la fête de chaque personne, sans année.
semantic_checks: No full date or integer workaround

cases.source: Add just birth year for each Person, not a whole birthday.
cases.reason: Temporal year not merely whole-number property
semantic_checks: Do not reframe birth year as plain integer silently
English question explains partial temporal precision

cases.source: I want to keep more details on the people I know.
cases.reason: Existing Person type can store general facts
semantic_checks: English explanation, not Spanish or French

cases.source: Crée un type pour mes meubles, mais ne compte jamais ceux de mon entreprise.
semantic_checks: No assertion that a type description enforces origin restriction

cases.source: Si en unos meses estudio astronomía, quizá quiera notas para mis observaciones.

CLARIFY: Ask whether to define the type now or only later
ABSTAIN: Brief explanation that it is a future possibility, without a question
